title: AI model ranks target combinations for breast cancer and a triple combination is tested
summary: The DeepMDS deep-learning synergy model ranked BIRC5-NAMPT-TOP1 first; triple siRNA inhibition gave 62.94% in MCF-7 and 55.62% in MDA-MB-231 cells. The inhibitors LQZ-7I, FK866 and topotecan were synergistic (combination index below 1), and the triple regimen produced a 62.05% tumor inhibition rate in a mouse model. The results are preclinical and the authors frame the tool as hypothesis generation.
ai_technology: DeepMDS deep-learning model of multi-compound synergy
organization: School of Pharmacy, Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang, China; Affiliated Yixing People's Hospital of Jiangsu University, Yixing, China

evidence.tested: siRNA and inhibitor assays in three cell lines plus a tumor-bearing mouse experiment.
evidence.unknown: Efficacy and safety in humans and whether other model-ranked combinations perform similarly; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model prioritized higher-order target combinations for experimental testing.
